تقتبلوا (form VIII)
# تَقْتَبِلُوا (taqtabilū) /taq.ta.bi.luː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِقْتَبَلَ (iqtabala)
# تُقْتَبَلُوا (tuqtabalū) /tuq.ta.ba.luː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِقْتَبَلَ (iqtabala)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
